name: Govindaraja Temple, Tirupati
reason: No correct coordinate exists in any citable source. English Wikipedia and Wikidata P625 both give 13.68325, 79.34719 — the Sri Venkateswara temple on Tirumala hill, roughly 20 km uphill from the Tirupati-town temple the article describes. Two sources agreeing does not make a coordinate true, and the atlas contradicts it: venkateswara-tirumala already occupies that point. Re-admit only with a coordinate from a source that puts it in Tirupati town.
